title: A Postcard for the Orchard
author: Petra Crane
blurb: Astrid Okafor, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, has spent seven years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
